subject: Risk & Compliance
title: AI-Powered Fraud Detection
description: Learn AI-Powered Fraud Detection in one minute.

hook.text: Your credit card company blocks a purchase before you even notice something wrong. AI spotted the anomaly.

buildup.text: Machine learning models analyze millions of transactions to detect patterns that signal fraud in real time.

discovery.text: AI catches fraud by comparing each transaction to your normal behavior. Deviations trigger instant alerts.

twist.text: Fraudsters use AI too — generating synthetic identities and adaptive attacks that evolve to evade detection.

climax.text: Fraud detection is an AI arms race. Both sides get smarter. The one with better data wins.

punchline.text: AI spots fraud in milliseconds. Criminals build AI to dodge it.

quiz.question: How does AI detect credit card fraud?
options: By comparing transactions to your normal behavior patterns
By monitoring your social media posts
